content:
Jun: Draft playbook for next Wed's 'LLM Inference Workshop' (45m demo + 15m Q&A). Main ops: registration page, Zoom recording+clips, HubSpot mapping, gated replay for 10 days, 3-email nurture. Link to staging reg page: https://staging.redwood.ai/events/llm-inference-workshop.

Ellie: quick checks: can we capture 'primary_interest' hidden field (options: cost, latency, ops) so we can send targeted follow-ups?

Jun: yes. add hidden field primary_interest. also set campaign=llm_workshop_apr in UTMs.

Marco: Zoom: cloud recording ON, auto-delete OFF, record speaker + shared screen, transcript enabled. I'll be host; Nora alt-host. We'll disable passcode and rely on reg. set join_before_host=10m.

Nora: I'll join 30 min early for AV check and make sure spotlight is working.

Ellie: HubSpot mapping notes (for Zapier webhook): email -> email, firstname -> first_name, last name -> last_name, company -> company, job_title -> title, primary_interest -> primary_interest, utm_campaign -> utm_campaign. Also create workflow to tag attendees with event:llm_inference_workshop.

Jun: post-event clips plan: produce 1 full recording + 4 short clips (0-5m intro, 15-18m benchmark, 22-25m demo, 40-45m Q&A). Owner: clips=Ellie, full=Nora. Export SRTs and upload to /assets/events/2026/llm-workshop/.

Marco: set Zoom reminders 48h and 1h prior. Also enable automatic transcript export.

Ellie: post-event email sequence:
- 0h: thanks + gated replay link (requires email to view)
- 24h: top 3 takeaways + CTA to trial (add +15 lead score on click)
- 5 days: benchmark PDF + invite to follow-up office hours
Add follow-up rule: if attendee watches >25 min or clicks trial -> route to AE inbox.

Jun: routing rule: company_size>200 OR title contains (Engineer,ML,Infrastructure) -> AE. else nurture. Also mark 'event_priority' high for those who clicked trial.

HubSpotBot: Test submission OK: jun+test@redwood.ai mapped and tag applied.

ZoomBot: Cloud recording scheduled for meeting 987654321. Auto-transcript enabled.

Nora: I'll run a test recording at 08:30 day-of. Ellie will confirm HubSpot field mapping after that.

Jun: final checklist for Wed 10am PT:
- [ ] Zoom meeting created + alt host set
- [ ] Registration page live + hidden field primary_interest
- [ ] HubSpot webhook & Zapier end-to-end tested
- [ ] Slack alert for new registrants -> #marketing-leads
- [ ] Clips owner briefed and SRT pipeline ready
- [ ] Email templates uploaded to HubSpot

Ellie: I'll post the social copy and schedule variants. Jun: will you approve?

Jun: approved. Ping in this thread when tests pass. :thumbsup:
